generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Corrigendums modifications correction if any will be published in the website only.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.
Acceptence / Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.
Corrigendums modifications correction if any will be published in the website only.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

All the materials to be utilized for the work must be tested in authorised labs and quality control test reports must be enclosed to the bills. All types of pipes and pumping machineries with Accessories and other materials must be tested by third party agencys. Cost of all QU tests must born by contractor
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered
Incomplete / conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number
The tender may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason

The rates of items are inclusive of cost of materials, labour charges, HOM of machinery, all lead and lifts and all other charges to complete the work successfully as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge of work
The tenderers must submit the scanned documents in pdf / jpeg form, not in other form.
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer , not in inward.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc., decision of Executive Engineer, RDW&S, Belgaum is final. and Binding
Bidder should Submit only unconditional Line of Credit in the prescribed format only from the Bank

Third party consults may be engaged for checking quality and quantity of work and to prevent any misuse. proper reporting methods trough these agencies and their comments to be reviewed addressed immediately at district level. quality of work is of most importance.

As per Karnatka State Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare Fund. & Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders.

Materials like pipe, CI pipe, cement aggregate sand etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and shall be of standard quality as per IS specifications and should get tested by the quality control authority before used to the work at his own cost.
The work should be carried out in accordance with the standard specifications specified by the department.

The work should be executed strictly as per the tender specification mentioned. Contractor should arrange for quality check at different stage of work for quality assurance as per direction of Engineer-in-charge during the work in progress and after completion. If any failures found the cost will be recovered from the contractor and will be recommended for black listing immediately.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders.
Tenderers must have valid PWD registration and must submit PWD registration copy Class IV & above
Achieved in at least One financial yearsa minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering Related construction works only) of Rs.6.36 Lakhs

Satisfactorily completed at least 90% of the contract valu, asPrime Contractor ,at least one Any nature work Water Supply related works of value not less than Rs.1.59 Lakhs not less than 25%of estimated value of contract certified by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer
The Tenderer should submit the Unconditional line of credit from Banker of a nationalized Bank / Scheduled Bank / liquid assets amounting to 30% of tender price. i.e. of Rs.1.90 Lakhs

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair of Water Purification Plant (WPP) In Budarakatti Habitation in Bailhongal Taluk in Belagavi District

itemList.description:
Raw Water Pump
To feed the Sand Filter & Carbon Filter - pressure more than 2.0 bar, which is min operating pressure for filter, Make: CRI / LEO / Lubi / CNP / equivalent-1.00 HP Self preming Raw water pump

High Pressure Pump To feed the Reverse Osmosis Membranes at pressure more than the osmosis pressure taking into Consideration flux rate, flow and recovery, Multistage pump of 1 Phase Motor.  Make: CRI / LEO / Lubi / CNP / Equivalent High Pressure Pump 2 HP Vertical multi stage pump (For 500 LPH & 1000 LPH) MVC type, single phase

Pressure Sand Filter:
Water is passed through multi layered of filter media consisting graded sand pebble and gravel layers.  The contaminants in the water are captured in the media bed.  And filtered water passes into the discharge main fold at the bottom of the tanks. The next and last step is back washing, the process of effectively removal of captured contaminants from the media bed.  After backwashing the filter, the filter is rinsed with the raw water and after the required quantity of the water is achieved and the filter is put back into service.
Sand Media: Silex, Pebbles, Fine sand - 50 kg bag
Make: Standard

Pressure Carbon Filter:
Using activated carbon to remove impurities from liquids or gases through absorption.  This process involves contaminants adhering to the surface of the carbon material, effectively trapping them within the filter's structure.
Carbon Granuals / Filter Media: 900 IV, 25 kg bagMOC: Coconut Shell based

RO Membrane:
An RO Membrane works on the principle of Reverse Osmosis to force water through semi permissible leaving behind impurities like salt, mineral and other contaminants.  This process separate the water into 2 streams like purified water and rejected impurities.
Membrane - 4040 BW (TFC)
RO Membrane - To remove the major part of TDS upto 98% by Reverse Osmosis Membranes arranged and designed to give adequate flow and recovery. 4" Dia with 40" Long, Make: Hydronautics / CSM / Aquashine / equivalent

Coin Box Repair Items:
A "coin box for water purifier" refers to a coin-operated mechanism that controls the dispensing of purified water from a water vending machine, often called a water ATM. These systems are designed to provide access to clean drinking water for a fee, making it accessible and affordable, especially in areas where piped water may be unreliable or unsafe.
